name: FluidForms
tagline: Static web forms result in incomplete submissions and wasted billable hours
description: Static web forms result in incomplete submissions and wasted billable hours. **FluidForms is the Intelligent Intake Engine that fixes this.** It acts as a 24/7 automated screener, interviewing clients and candidates for you. How It Works * **Reads Documents Instantly:** Users upload unstructured files like resumes, case reports, or voice notes. FluidForms extracts critical info and auto-fills the data. * **Asks Follow-Ups:** Unlike rigid forms, the AI dynamically asks natural follow-up questions
